first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: gray head-and-chest bust
entities.identification: The dark gray hairless head sculpture above the center of the rotating platform, with a long neck and a cross-section of the shoulders.

entities.name: white two-tier rotating platform
entities.identification: A white, flat, rounded two-tier base with a narrow black gap between the tiers and a black circular control area on the front of the base.

entities.name: white rectangular backdrop panel
entities.identification: The large bright white rectangular panel behind the bust.

entities.name: dark gray studio wall
entities.identification: The dark gray wall outside the white backdrop panel, with slightly mottled light and dark areas.

entities.name: black foreground camera
entities.identification: The black camera in the lower-left foreground in frame 0, with a flip-out screen, buttons, and a green indicator light on the back.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The partially visible person in the left foreground in frame 0, with a skin-toned arm or hand and a black sleeve exposed.

entities.name: light-colored textured tabletop
entities.identification: The light gray-white horizontal tabletop beneath the rotating platform, with irregular gray-brown patterns.

entities.name: bar-shaped light fixture at the top
entities.identification: The dark, slender lamp head extending horizontally near the upper edge of the backdrop panel, with its right end connected to a light-colored arm.

entities.name: black light stand on the right
entities.identification: The black vertical rod stand to the right of the backdrop panel, with clamps and knobs.

entities.name: black grooved panel on the left
entities.identification: The black vertical panel at the image-left edge in the near foreground, with parallel grooves arranged in sections and running in different directions.

entities.name: “REMOTE CONTROL” subtitle graphic
entities.identification: An overlay graphic composed of bold black uppercase text and red thin-line frame corners.

entities.name: bar graphic below “Ecommerce”
entities.identification: The horizontal white outline at the bottom of the image and the white word Ecommerce at its center.
